zh: 利雅德機場關閉至17 October，重開日未定。
en: King Khalid International Airport remains closed until 17 October; reopening date unknown.

zh: 漢莎航空最後四架A340-600預定10月退出客運服務
en: Lufthansa plans to withdraw its final four A340-600s from passenger service in October.

zh: 法國預計推進Rafale F5及ACF戰機計畫。
en: France is expected to advance Rafale F5 and ACF fighter programmes.

zh: 探勘隊赴 Nikumaroro 調查疑似 Amelia Earhart 飛機線索
en: Expedition investigates a possible clue to Amelia Earhart’s missing aircraft at Nikumaroro.

zh: 利雅德機場週日僅1班離場，99.7%取消或未飛
en: Riyadh airport recorded one departure; 99.7% were cancelled or not flown.

zh: Aegean任命Michalis Kouveliotis為執行長，Gerogiannis交接期間續任顧問。
en: Aegean appoints Michalis Kouveliotis CEO; Gerogiannis will advise during transition.

zh: Vietjet擴大與Collins合作，支援44架A320neo系列飛機。
en: Vietjet expands Collins support for 44 additional A320neo family jets.

zh: 空中巴士公佈10月5日至9日股票回購交易
en: Airbus reports share buyback transactions for 5–9 October.

zh: 達美航空將亞特蘭大—利雅德航線延至2027年3月
en: Delta postpones Atlanta–Riyadh launch until March 2027

zh: 美國聯邦航空總署要求空中巴士A380拆除15具高壓渦輪級間封嚴
en: FAA orders removal of 15 high pressure turbine interstage seals on Airbus A380
